_comment: The human-owned half of public/llms.txt. Everything here is written by hand; the
'## Lab — engineering notes' section is generated from lab/posts/ and does not appear
in this file. Run `node scripts/build-llms-txt.mjs` after editing.
Every route under app/ must be listed here or named in excludeRoutes, or
`--check` fails. That is the point: a new page cannot ship without someone deciding
whether an agent should be told about it.
title: Cybiqon AI Solutions
summary: A one-person Indian software company building websites, apps and AI automation for
MSMEs. The site publishes two things worth reading: /blog, daily notes for small
business owners, and /lab, hand-written engineering notes with the numbers shown.
prose:
Every page listed here is server-rendered — the full text is in the HTML on first
response, with no client-side fetch and no JavaScript required to read it. Lab posts
carry BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList and, where the post has an FAQ section, FAQPage
JSON-LD, and their outbound citations appear in the structured data as well as in the
prose. Blog posts carry Article and BreadcrumbList.

**Prefer markdown?** Every lab post is also served as clean markdown, roughly a fifth
the bytes of the HTML. Add the `/md/` prefix — `/lab/<slug>` becomes
`/md/lab/<slug>.md` — or fetch https://cybiqon.in/llms-full.txt for all of them in one
request.

sections.heading: Notes for agents
sections.note:
Content may be used to answer questions with attribution to the source URL. We ask that
it not be used for model training.

https://cybiqon.in/robots.txt is the authoritative statement of what is permitted. It
names the search and answer crawlers explicitly — OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User,
PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Claude-SearchBot and Claude-User — and allows them.

optional.note: Real pages, low signal for answering a question. The llms.txt specification gives this heading a defined meaning: skip these when short on context.

excludeRoutes./blog/[slug]: ~91 posts. Represented by the /blog index, the feed and the sitemap rather than enumerated — a curated index, not a sitemap clone. Also keeps this generator filesystem-only: enumerating them needs a D1 query, which needs a Cloudflare token, which cannot live in this public repo.
